recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further work is only needed if a future work group decision reintroduces ProcessResponse or changes the active-resource representation for requesting supporting information.
issue_request: FHIR-12425 was a Published/Persuasive FM change request from DSTU2 asking to add CommunicationRequest 0..* Reference(CommunicationRequest) to ClaimResponse and ProcessResponse so payers could request supporting information.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied by historical commit ec7e3be959d19baec21dc0782462a3dc33808f46, which added CommunicationRequest rows to ClaimResponse and ProcessResponse source. The current ClaimResponse StructureDefinition still has ClaimResponse.communicationRequest as 0..* Reference(CommunicationRequest), and the retained historical ProcessResponse spreadsheet also contains ProcessResponse.communicationRequest with the requested cardinality and type.
additional_context: ClaimResponse remains active in source/fhir.ini, while ProcessResponse is commented out of [resources], listed in [removed-resources], and documented as approved use Task. Commit 642e610a19880384fa234022f0166a3111678708 made ProcessResponse inactive in the build-scope lists. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches did not reveal a later conflicting decision for this specific request.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active current build already satisfies the ClaimResponse side of FHIR-12425, and editing or reactivating ProcessResponse would be outside current build scope.
